The fixed rail0..B−1 contains every rescued iterate, sinceB is absent fromU. StartingK0={0}, the p-step monotone map givesK0⊆Kp⊆K2p⊆…; each strict inclusion increases cardinality.

At the first equal-endpoint p-block, no rescue occurred because rescues increase cardinality while ordinary updates preserve it. The block is therefore a genuine immortal periodic phase of capacityν≤B. If j strict blocks preceded it, j≤ν−1 and h=jp≤p(ν−1); detecting it costs(j+1)p≤pν updates.
